description: This file defines the ShippingAddress controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages the display and processing of shipping address data during checkout, including loading addresses, validating input, saving address information, and updating session data.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling shipping address selection and management during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping address form, populating it with the user's existing addresses and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the submitted shipping address data, updating session and database as needed.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets a specific address as the shipping address based on provided address ID.
